chunks: My father narrated, may God be pleased with him, who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Isfahani, from Al-Sulayman ibn Dawood al-Minqari, who said: Hammad ibn Isa narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, made incumbent upon you the five prayers at the best of times, so you are commanded to offer supplication after the prayers.

key_terms.أَدْبَارِ الصَّلَوَاتِ: After the prayers (literally: the heels/back of the prayers)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice after performing the five daily prayers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to emphasize the spiritual potency of the post-prayer supplications (ad'at al-salawat), which are considered a time when prayers are readily accepted. This instruction highlights the transition from the ritual act of prayer to personal communion with God, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the continuity of worship beyond the formal prayer structure.
